text.summary: microblog is a social media application where users can post messages, follow others, and interact with content. It includes features like user authentication, password reset, and message sending.
text.how_it_works: A request starts at app/main/routes.py::index, which handles both GET and POST requests. It uses Flask to route requests to the appropriate functions. Authentication is handled by app/auth/routes.py::login and app/auth/routes.py::logout. User data is stored in a SQL database through Flask-SQLAlchemy, and interactions with the database are managed by SQLAlchemy ORM. Background tasks are handled by RQ, which uses Redis as a queue. The app also uses Elasticsearch for search functionality and Flask-Mail for sending emails.
